Government offices cannot require COVID vaccination, so the relief shelter accepts everyone without screening. A traveler is exposed there and spends the next day too weak to walk beside the van.
bills.summary: Ban government from requiring COVID vaccination

bills.description: A fresh ban on COVID vaccination requirements removes the checkpoint's only health safeguard. A traveler catches the infection in the crowd and leaves your party short-handed.
Another vaccine requirement disappears at the border clinic, and a ferry crowd arrives with fewer people protected. A traveler catches a spreading illness and cannot help push the van through mud.
Childhood vaccination is eliminated from the school calendar, and the clinic packs away its small syringes. A young traveler falls ill after the next crowded lesson.
A health lecturer urges people to distrust vaccination, and one traveler follows the warning. The traveler contracts the outbreak at a depot, forcing the party to delay departure.
Schools are forbidden from requiring COVID-19 vaccination, so the dormitory fills despite a spreading cough. A traveler becomes sick there and must be carried back to the van.
The blood bank sorts donations by vaccination status into separate shelves. After an accident, your party waits while staff search both inventories, and a wounded traveler grows pale.

A COVID-19 requirement ban means the fair no longer checks vaccination status, and residents crowd the public health table less often. A traveler catches the infection there and coughs through the party's long climb.
Physicians must discourage vaccination during consultations, so the clinic talks a traveler out of a needed dose. The resulting illness leaves the traveler weak through the next mountain pass.
Meat from vaccinated livestock is banned, and the butcher discards a safe shipment. Your party buys questionable replacements, and a traveler develops stomach cramps before the next camp.
A constitutional right to refuse vaccination is painted across the clinic wall. A traveler invokes it, then catches the infection circulating through the crowded hostel.
A ban on mRNA vaccines closes the only clinic offering a traveler's recommended dose. By the time another provider appears, the traveler is exposed and spends the next stretch feverish.
The settlement celebrates a right to refuse vaccines by closing its outreach booth. A traveler skips protection and later coughs through the van's cramped nights.
A new law bans vaccination requirements everywhere, even at the crowded ferry terminal. A traveler boards beside an infectious stranger and falls ill before the crossing ends.
The hepatitis B requirement disappears from a roadside clinic's checklist. A traveler misses the routine dose and later faces a frightening infection after a contaminated mishap.

A school counselor encourages students to skip vaccination, and a traveler follows the advice. The traveler becomes sick during a crowded exam day and slows the whole party.

bills.summary: Ban state from working with ATF to enforce gun laws

bills.description: A rifle is stolen from your camp, but local officers say federal gun rules cannot be enforced here. The crowd scatters your supplies, and a traveler cuts a palm scrambling after a rolling first-aid kit.
bills.summary: Ban on state enforcing federal gun laws

bills.description: Your party camps beside a creek filmed with oily rainbow after state officials nullify federal environmental protections. An unwary sip leaves several travelers vomiting and weak, forcing a grim search for clean water.
bills.summary: Allows nullification of federal environmental laws

bills.description: Every checkpoint has a different list of laws the state claims it will ignore. Rerouting around contradictory orders leaves your party driving after dark, and a traveler strains a wrist unloading supplies by flashlight.
bills.summary: Declaration it'll ignore federal laws it doesn't like

bills.description: A federal inspection crew is turned away as the state declares its action unconstitutional. Their standoff blocks the road, and your party waits in punishing heat until a traveler becomes dizzy and nearly collapses.
bills.summary: Allows state to ignore federal actions it deems unconstitutional

bills.description: A courthouse caravan announces that a supreme court impeachment order is unconstitutional, and armed supporters fill the road. Your party detours through a muddy field, where a traveler slips and sprains an ankle.
bills.summary: Declaring a state supreme court order regarding impeachment unconstitutional

bills.description: A checkpoint officer insists the state's new nullification power lets them reject the federal inspection papers your driver presents. The argument lasts through the hottest part of the afternoon, leaving a traveler faint beneath the metal awning.
bills.summary: Allows Kentucky to nullify federal laws

bills.description: Two officials at the roadblock disagree about whether the state's nullification order overrides a federal safety closure. Your van sits between their barricades while they argue, and a traveler runs out of water in the afternoon heat.
A state opts out of a federal safety regulation, so the repair yard removes its warning signs and guards. A loose board snaps beneath your van, damaging a wheel and bruising a traveler.
bills.summary: Allows state to opt out of federal regulations

bills.description: Officials declare a federal emergency action unconstitutional and pull the road crews away. Building a shaky crossing at the washed-out culvert leaves a traveler with splinters and a deep forearm cut.
bills.summary: Allows state to declare federal actions unconstitutional

bills.description: The state nullifies a federal rule overnight, and merchants change prices and paperwork before sunrise. Your party's food crate is held until the heat spoils it, leaving travelers hungry and light-headed.

A weapons-shipment investigation stalls outside the campground when local officers refuse federal enforcement. A threatening argument sends your party scrambling into the van, and a traveler catches their hand in the sliding door.
bills.summary: Ban any federal enforcement of gun laws

bills.description: The state has rejected a federal road-safety order, but the federal crew still has the bridge barricaded. Your driver doubles back along a badly rutted track, and the jolting ride aggravates a traveler's back injury.
bills.summary: Allows state to nullify federal laws

bills.description: The state nullifies only the federal laws it dislikes, leaving travelers to guess which rules survive. A checkpoint seizes your cooking fuel, and the party eats cold food while a traveler develops stomach cramps.
bills.summary: Allows state to nullify federal laws that it doesn't like

bills.description: A broad permission for nullification turns a ferry landing into a shouting match between rival officials. The storm floods the bank, and a traveler goes to bed hungry after the grain is ruined.

A clinic refuses to honor the federal court decision a traveler brought as proof of their right to care, citing the state's nullification rule. The traveler returns to the van untreated, with pain growing sharper as the road climbs.
bills.summary: Allows state to nullify Supreme Court decisions that it doesn't like

bills.description: At the motel, officers say the state's enforcement ban prevents them helping federal agents pursue a threatening gun dealer. Your party retreats from a confrontation in the lot; a traveler falls across a parking curb and twists an ankle.
bills.summary: Ban federal enforcement of gun laws

bills.summary: Authorizing state treasurer to invest in crypto

bills.description: The public campground's new crypto payment option is down just as your party arrives, and the sole clerk is buried in failed transactions. Waiting in a line without shade leaves a traveler dizzy before anyone can assign you a site.
bills.summary: Let state accept payments in crypto

bills.description: With crypto gains untaxed, a speculator crowds the general store and buys every spare fuel can. Your party burns precious firewood, and a traveler wakes coughing after sleeping in the smoke.
A gun range owner enjoys limited liability and leaves a cracked backstop beside the trail. A ricochet tears your water bag, and rationing leaves a traveler dizzy with dehydration.
bills.summary: Limiting liability of gun range owners

A flat tax leaves the remote road district short of maintenance funds. Your party's van sinks into an unrepaired rut, and everyone must unload sacks before the wheels can turn.
The state may invest in Bitcoin, and officials do so with money meant for bridge inspections. Your party hears a plank crack under the van and retreats before the span gives way.
bills.summary: Allows state to invest in bitcoin

bills.description: The state invests in crypto and sells reserve grain to cover a bad trade. Your party reaches the depot to find empty bins and must forage along a longer, rougher route.

A roadside employer uses the newly permitted Bitcoin payment route for a traveler's day wages. The transfer gets stuck before dinner can be bought, leaving the traveler shaky and hungry beside the van.
bills.summary: Require businesses be able to make payments in Bitcoin

bills.description: Bitcoin is integrated into state payments, and the toll system goes offline during a software update. Your party misses the supply convoy and reaches camp with empty water jugs.
The town cut its road-maintenance budget after reducing corporate taxes. Your van drops into a pothole deep enough to slam a traveler's head against the window, leaving them dazed and nauseated.
An estate-tax cut leaves less money for the county ambulance service. A traveler faints from heat at a roadside stop, and your party carries them miles before finding aid.
A corporate tax cut lets a haulage company expand its fleet without funding safer routes. A speeding truck clips your van mirror, and a broken shard cuts a traveler's hand.
State DOGE auditors slash roadside services without checking the route. Your party arrives at a shuttered weigh station, where a missing warning sign sends the van onto a weak plank road.

Auditors gut roadside offices under a state-level DOGE program and close the nearest ranger station. Your party loses the marked route around a rockslide, and a traveler twists an ankle scrambling over rubble.

The state must invest in crypto, and a collapse drains the account for trail-side wells. Your party finds the pump dry and carries water uphill until shoulders ache.
bills.summary: Require state to invest in crypto

bills.description: The state invests in crypto and sells reserve grain to cover a bad trade. Your party reaches the depot to find empty bins and must forage along a longer, rougher route.
The state invests in Bitcoin while prices swing wildly, postponing a food inspection. Your party buys a sealed crate that has spoiled inside and discovers the problem only at supper.
Officials urge investment in Bitcoin, and a town clerk abandons the permit desk to trade. Your party waits through the closing bell and misses the only ferry of the day.
bills.summary: Urge state to invest in bitcoin

bills.description: The state lets its treasury invest in Bitcoin, and a sharp drop shutters a repair depot. Your party patches a split tire with canvas and crawls onward at a slow pace.

The town closes its main street for a ceremony honoring the corporate lobbyist. Your party ends up parked blocks from its motel; carrying supplies through the heat leaves a traveler dizzy and nauseated.
bills.summary: Honor Susie Wiles, a corporate lobbyist

bills.description: A trainee opts out of professional licensing for religious reasons and opens an uninspected roadside clinic. A traveler receives poor treatment for a sprain, swelling badly before your party finds proper care.
bills.summary: Allows people to opt out of professional licensing requirements for religious reasons

bills.description: The treasury's required crypto purchases have plunged in value, delaying the rural clinic's supply order. A traveler finds their needed medicine out of stock and returns to the van with their symptoms worsening.
bills.summary: Forcing state to invest in crypto

bills.description: A subsidy makes cryptocurrency cheap to buy, and townspeople empty the cooperative's cash reserve. Your party arrives for flour and finds the shelves bare, then forages for supper.
After the ban on progressive taxation, the county cuts maintenance at its remote rest areas. A rotten step gives way under a traveler at the washroom, leaving a swollen ankle for the drive ahead.
An impeached officer keeps drawing a salary while the office stops answering emergency calls. Your party waits beside the broken van, and a traveler develops heat exhaustion before help appears.
bills.summary: Allow impeached officers to continue getting their salary

bills.description: The official under impeachment remains in charge of the permit desk and refuses to acknowledge the complaint about your party's delay. Hours standing on the pavement leave a traveler's injured knee throbbing.
bills.summary: Allow impeached officials to continue their jobs

bills.description: State DOGE auditors slash roadside services without checking the route. Your party arrives at a shuttered weigh station, where a missing warning sign sends the van onto a weak plank road.
A Strategic Bitcoin Reserve absorbs money set aside for disaster response. When a flash flood cuts the route, your party finds no sandbags and watches its lowest supply crate float away.

A market seller waves a notice of the new constitutional crypto right as though it guarantees the token they're selling. A traveler trusts the pitch and cannot recover their travel money, then goes without dinner and wakes trembling with hunger.
The state has tied up its cash reserve in gold and delayed repairs to the campground's pump. Your party carries water uphill from another site until a traveler's shoulders spasm under the load.

The county drops a roadside shelter grant after eliminating capital-gains taxes. Your party arrives in driving rain to find the shelter locked, and a traveler spends a miserable night shivering in wet clothes.
The estate tax vanishes, and a promised bridge fund disappears with it. Your party reaches a gap in the road and spends a cold night redirecting the van around the ravine.
A capital-gains cut fuels a rush to buy land along the trail. Construction crews fence the usual rest meadow, and the long search for water leaves a traveler faint with dehydration.

The exchange operator shrugs at your traveler's missing deposit, pointing to the new protections against complaints. With the supply budget trapped, the traveler stretches a packet of crackers into dinner and grows weak loading the van.
bills.summary: Make it easier to rip off crypto holders

bills.description: Crypto regulation is banned, and a coin exchange opens in the feed store. Its servers fail during a rush, trapping your party's payment and leaving travelers weak from missing supper.
Crypto becomes legal tender, but its value tumbles between the pump and the register. The attendant cancels the sale, and your party spends the night siphoning fuel from an unreliable can.
The state abolishes income tax and closes the rural clinic to balance its budget. A traveler's infection spreads while your party searches for a pharmacist willing to help.

A rally demanding the end of federal income tax takes over the plaza outside the relief office. Your party is caught in its shouting crowd, and a traveler bruises a rib against a barricade while trying to reach the van.
A corporate tax cut lets a haulage company expand its fleet without funding safer routes. A speeding truck clips your van mirror, and a broken shard cuts a traveler's hand.
A loss on the state's crypto investment has delayed payment to the road-grading crew. Your van lurches through an unfinished repair, wrenching a traveler's neck against the headrest.
bills.summary: Allows state to invest in crypto

bills.description: State DOGE cuts staff at the navigation office and removes old route markers. Your party follows a faded arrow into a marsh, where the van sinks axle-deep.
The state paid its ferry contractor in crypto, and a conversion problem has left the crew refusing to work. Your party waits on the exposed landing until a traveler becomes faint from the heat.
bills.summary: Allow state to make payments in crypto

bills.description: A roadside dealer offers an untraceable crypto discount, boasting about the new loophole for hiding the transaction. They disappear with the payment; a traveler goes without supper to keep the van moving and wakes dizzy with hunger.
bills.summary: Incentivizes using crypto to break the law

bills.description: A heavy truck no longer held to the lower speed limit barrels past on the grade. Its trailer clips your mirror, and a shower of glass leaves a traveler's arm bleeding.
bills.summary: Do away with lower speed limits for trucks over 13 tons

bills.description: An oversized night load squeezes your van onto the unlit shoulder. The wheel drops into a rut and the seat belt bites hard across a traveler's ribs, leaving every breath painful.
bills.summary: Allow oversize truck loads to be on the road 24 hours a day

bills.description: The roadside scooter rental stops requiring helmets after the law is repealed. A traveler takes one on a quick supply run, skids on gravel, and returns with a throbbing head and scraped cheek.
Lead limits in pipes rise, and the campground posts a notice that its old pipes are unsafe. Your party hikes for a clean source, leaving a traveler dizzy and dehydrated.
bills.summary: Increasing the amount of lead that can be in pipes

bills.description: Towns can no longer regulate pesticides, so a field is sprayed beside the road without a buffer. The drifting mist irritates several travelers' eyes and forces your party to abandon camp.
Pesticide sprayers receive immunity for their work and skip the warning flags. Your party walks through a treated verge, and a traveler breaks out in a rash before sunset.
bills.summary: Gives immunity to people who spray pesticides

bills.description: Roundup liability disappears, and a distributor stores leaking drums beside the trail. Rain carries the residue into your water barrel, leaving the party searching for a clean spring.
State lawsuits against Bayer over Roundup are barred, so a damaged farm receives no cleanup help. Your party crosses its runoff ditch and spends the night washing chemical stink from its blankets.
bills.summary: Bans state lawsuits against Bayer for Roundup

bills.description: State lawsuits against Bayer over Roundup are barred, so a damaged farm receives no cleanup help. Your party crosses its runoff ditch and spends the night washing chemical stink from its blankets.
bills.summary: Bans state lawsuits against Bayer for Roundup

bills.description: A Roundup bailout keeps a careless depot operating after a spill. Your party's tires roll through the slick and track residue into the van, tainting food sacks and canvas.
Pesticide rules loosen, and a grower sprays through a warm afternoon with no notice. Your party's throat burns in the drifting cloud, forcing a long detour around the fields.

State PFAS standards are repealed, and the rest stop's old foam suppressant contaminates its supply. Your party finds a notice closing the tap and hikes for water until a traveler develops heat exhaustion.
PFAS protections are deregulated, allowing a factory to drain treated water toward the campground. A contamination notice closes the faucet, and the hot hike to a safe source leaves a traveler faint.
Rules on PFAS are loosened, and a new disposal pit opens near the trail. A warning closes the nearby water point, and the long walk for clean water leaves a traveler with cracked lips and dizziness.
Lead-solder rules loosen at the roadside pump, and a notice declares the drinking tap unsafe. Your party hauls fresh containers from a distant creek, leaving a traveler exhausted and light-headed.
Contaminants can be released into drinking water more easily, and a mill flushes its holding pond upstream. Your party boils the cloudy supply, but several travelers still suffer cramps.
bills.summary: Makes it easier to release contaminants into drinking water

bills.description: Pesticide makers lose state causes of action, so a leaking shipment remains on the roadside. Your party's van brushes the crates, and a sticky chemical film ruins its spare clothing.
bills.summary: Eliminates state causes of action against pesticide manufacturers

bills.description: Spraying without warnings becomes easier, and an orchard is treated just as your party passes. A traveler inhales the plume, wheezing until the van reaches clear air.
bills.summary: Makes it easier to spray pesticides without warning

bills.description: The diner wall carries a resolution urging expanded use of cyanide predator traps; outside, a rancher boasts about setting one near the path to the creek. Your party scrambles away from a suspicious device, and a traveler tears their palm on barbed wire.
bills.summary: Urge Congress to permit use of M-44 sodium cyanide canisters

bills.description: Lead-paint monitoring is limited, and flakes peel from the bunkhouse walls. Your party sleeps there during rain; a traveler wakes coughing and the group scrubs dust from every blanket.

A new industrial project abandons its carbon-capture plan after the ban, and its construction traffic blocks the only road to your motel. Your van idles behind diesel trucks for an hour, leaving a traveler coughing in the trapped fumes.
bills.summary: Banning carbon capture in the state

bills.description: The state cannot bring a Roundup case against Bayer, and a cleanup crew abandons a contaminated field. Your party's boots carry residue into the van, spoiling the floor mat and a food sack.
bills.summary: Eliminates state law cause of action against Bayer for Roundup

bills.description: Pesticide manufacturers face no state cause of action, so an old storage tank remains unsealed. Your party camps nearby and wakes to a sharp odor, with several travelers nauseated.
bills.summary: Eliminates state level cause of action against pesticides

bills.description: Fees for air and water cleanup are banned, and the town stops collecting runoff funds. Your party reaches a river thick with algae and must haul water from a narrow, muddy seep.
bills.summary: Ban any fees that could go to cleaning up air or water

bills.description: Oil and gas companies gain limited liability for waste, leaving a drilling pit unfenced beside the trail. A van wheel slips into oily sludge, and a traveler strains their back hauling it free.
bills.summary: Limits liability for creating oil & gas waste

bills.description: Water pollution becomes easier, and a mine discharges rust-colored water into the crossing creek. Your party avoids drinking it, but the long detour leaves a traveler nauseated from heat and thirst.
bills.summary: Make it easier to pollute water

bills.description: PFAS discharges carry little liability, so a plant releases foam into the drainage ditch. Your party's filter clogs with residue, and rationing the remaining clean water leaves a traveler dizzy with dehydration.
Emissions testing ends, and a smoky truck joins the highway with a failing exhaust. Your party follows it through the pass, coughing and slowing whenever the fumes thicken.
Water rules may be no stricter than federal ones, so a town stops enforcing its creek protections. Your party finds dead fish downstream and spends the day finding another place to fill barrels.
bills.summary: Requiring state laws be no more stringent regulating water pollution than federal ones

bills.description: Vehicle emissions testing disappears, and a bus belches black smoke beside your party's car. The driver loses visibility, drifts onto the shoulder, and punctures a tire on roadside debris.
Clean-water standards vanish at the reservoir crossing. Your party boils the murky water, but the fuel needed for that extra fire leaves little for the next cold camp.

Officials encourage releasing CO2, and a carbon-intensive expansion worsens the valley's summer heat. Your party makes frequent stops, while a traveler develops a pounding headache and heat exhaustion.
bills.summary: Encourage putting CO2 in the atmosphere

bills.description: After liability protections leave a pesticide spill unresolved, the usual path to the campground is fenced off. Carrying your supplies around the long detour leaves a traveler with a strained shoulder and raw blisters.
bills.summary: Eliminate state level cause of action against pesticide manufacturers

bills.description: Your party stops at a town building where workers are taking down a Pride flag under the ban. A bystander starts heckling a traveler who objects, and the confrontation leaves them shaking through a panic attack in the van.

A traveler collecting adoption documents is turned away when the agency learns their spouse is the same sex. The agency cites its new freedom to discriminate; the traveler spends the night calling for help, too distressed to sleep.
bills.summary: Allow adoption agencies to discriminate against gay parents

bills.description: The pride flag ban reaches roadside buildings, and a clinic removes the flag that helped travelers find it. Your party misses the entrance during a storm and spends hours searching while a traveler worsens.
A total ban on required pronouns lets station staff choose mocking forms of address. The confrontation panics a traveler, who hyperventilates while your party waits for a calmer intake clerk.
bills.summary: Total ban on forcing people to use specific pronouns

bills.summary: Allow private entities to ignore marriage equality

bills.description: A town cancels its Pride display, and a traveler who had planned to sell handmade patches loses the chance to participate. The rejection triggers a tearful panic episode and trembling hands.

bills.description: A traveler hangs a small pride flag from the van, and an officer orders it removed under threat of arrest. The confrontation leaves the traveler shaking, with a stress headache that lasts into morning.

bills.description: At a town tutoring program, a teacher refuses to use a traveler’s chosen nickname. The traveler leaves in tears, nauseated and unable to concentrate on the road.

A school shelter removes its lesson on gay history before your party arrives, leaving one traveler feeling erased. They withdraw into a sleepless silence and develop a pounding headache.
bills.summary: Ban students from learning about gay people

bills.description: A clinic pamphlet labels a trans traveler mentally ill and recommends a coercive program. The traveler skips needed follow-up care, and the party must manage a worsening headache on the road.
A trans traveler walking near a school is warned they are violating a wide exclusion zone. The confrontation leaves them panicked and dizzy, needing to sit before the party can continue.
bills.summary: Bans transgender people from within 2500 feet of schools

bills.description: A children’s library cancels a drag story hour just as your party arrives, and a performer traveling with you is questioned outside. The humiliating scene sends a child traveler into a panic.
At a school shelter, a counselor refuses to answer a young traveler’s question about same-sex families. Confusion turns into a tearful argument, leaving the traveler hoarse and exhausted.
A married traveler hears officials again asking to undo marriage equality and stuffs their certificate into a backpack. Their panic causes nausea and a sleepless night before the next drive.
A couple signs a covenant marriage form at a county office, believing it is routine, then learns leaving will require a much harder process. One partner’s shock brings trembling and stomach cramps.
Two partners in your van decide they cannot safely stay together, but the local clerk says a simple divorce is no longer available. They remain trapped in a tense, sleepless journey.
A roadside couple discovers their covenant vows are recognized with strict conditions they never understood. The dispute leaves one partner sobbing, with a migraine that blurs the afternoon.
A clerk validates a covenant marriage for a couple traveling west, and later explains that ending it will demand proof of fault. The revelation leaves one partner shaking and unable to eat.
bills.summary: Allows legal recognition of covenant marriage

bills.description: A traveler fleeing an abusive spouse learns the county will not process a no-fault divorce. Fear keeps them awake and hypervigilant, flinching at every vehicle behind the party.
A newly married pair accepts a covenant ceremony at a roadside chapel without reading the fine print. When they try to separate, one partner breaks down sobbing and cannot sleep.
A county recognizes a couple’s covenant vows, then refuses their request for a quick separation. Tempers flare outside the courthouse, and one partner leaves with a bruised wrist.
A traveler seeking a clean break from a failing marriage is told the no-fault route has vanished. The unresolved conflict causes trembling, insomnia, and a miserable silent drive.
A state study on ending no-fault divorce sends a traveler into panic about an already unsafe marriage. They miss a medication refill and spend the night shaking with anxiety.
bills.summary: Study on eliminating no fault divorce

bills.description: A traveler begs police to temporarily remove a volatile relative’s gun, but the request is dismissed under the new rule. A threatening call triggers a panic attack and trembling hands.
After a gun is stolen from a roadside vehicle, investigators cannot follow the purchase trail. The shaken traveler develops a stress headache while answering questions for hours.
bills.summary: Make it harder for law enforcement to track gun purchases

bills.description: An unlocked gun disappears from a dealer’s back room and turns up near your campsite. The sudden gunfire scare leaves a traveler bruised while scrambling into the van.
bills.summary: Removes requirements of gun dealers to secure guns

bills.description: An eighteen-year-old traveler buys a pistol before the crossing and keeps showing it off at rest stops. A careless stumble sends a painful shot through the van’s interior.
bills.summary: Lower age to carry a gun to 18

bills.description: During a church service, a dispute over your parking spot escalates because everyone assumes they may stand their ground. A traveler is injured in the scramble to leave.
A stranger at a fuel station draws a gun during an argument over the pump and claims the law protects them. A traveler ducks behind the van and bruises their shoulder on the bumper.
A traveler buys a high-capacity magazine and fires a reckless extended burst behind camp. The noise and flying debris cut a traveler’s cheek and send everyone scrambling.
bills.summary: Legalize high capacity magazines and destroy records of them

bills.description: A campsite quarrel turns dangerous when a neighbor reaches for a gun and refuses to retreat. A traveler spends the night shaking and sleepless in the locked van.
A judge arrives at a roadside hearing armed, and a frightened witness refuses to enter the room. The witness hyperventilates and must sit down while your party waits.
bills.summary: Allows judges to bring guns to court

bills.description: A dormitory stop feels unsafe when students carry concealed guns through the hallways. One traveler drops a suitcase during a sudden alarm and sprains their wrist.
A young traveler buys a gun without the former age limit and carries it into a crowded diner. A dropped bag causes a stampede that bruises two members of the party.
bills.summary: Eliminates limits on people under 21 on purchasing guns

bills.description: At a school event, a concealed-carry permit holder’s weapon becomes visible during an argument. A child traveler panics, vomits behind the van, and cannot settle for hours.
bills.summary: Allows anyone with a concealed carry permit to bring guns to a school

bills.description: A teenager in your party is offered a gun by a dealer who treats inexperience as a selling point. The teen mishandles it near camp, causing a painful graze.
bills.summary: Make it easier for teens to get guns

bills.description: A bus driver carrying a gun reaches for it when traffic stops suddenly, sending passengers scrambling. Your party misses its connection and one traveler hits the pavement.
bills.summary: Lets school bus drivers carry guns

bills.description: A man waves a pistol at your van while insisting it is self-defense. Everyone ducks below the windows, and one traveler’s panic leaves them dizzy and short of breath.
bills.summary: Let people wave guns around as self-defense

bills.description: A traveler’s unregistered gun is stolen from the van, leaving no clear record for police to use. The traveler lies awake trembling, replaying how the theft happened.
bills.summary: Repeals requirement that gun owners register for ID cards

bills.description: A passenger boards with a concealed gun despite the transport company’s old prohibition, and it is discovered only after a confrontation. A traveler is knocked down in the rush and bruises a hip.
bills.summary: Removes state law ban against taking guns on transportation, including planes

bills.description: A campus clinic visit becomes chaotic when armed students rush past the waiting room. A traveler postpones treatment, and the untreated infection worsens during the next miles.
bills.summary: Allows concealed carry on college campuses

bills.description: A young traveler obtains a permit before they have learned safe handling. While unloading at camp, they cut their hand and lose the use of it for the day.
bills.summary: Lowers age where you can get a gun permit

bills.description: Police cannot act quickly on a warning that a relative is threatening violence because red-flag enforcement has been blocked. A traveler’s fear causes insomnia and a pounding headache.
bills.summary: Ban on enforcing red flag laws

bills.description: A local teenager carries concealed at a crowded market, where a dropped jacket exposes the weapon. The panic scatters the party, and one traveler falls and scrapes both knees.
A school hallway permits firearms again, and a sudden shout sends everyone running. One traveler falls against a locker and needs a splint before the van can leave.
bills.summary: Repeals ban on carrying guns in schools

bills.description: At a Mardi Gras parade, a gun appears above the crowd during a dispute. Your party pushes through the crush, leaving a traveler with a dislocated shoulder.
A clerk fails to report a threatening gun owner because the reporting requirement disappeared. The confrontation leaves a traveler shaking so badly they cannot hold the water bottle.
bills.summary: Eliminates red flag law reporting requirements

bills.description: An eighteen-year-old traveler receives a gun permit before understanding its responsibilities. A careless attempt to secure it damages the van and cuts their forearm.
A coworker brings a gun into the repair shop where your traveler finds temporary work. An argument over a toolbox leaves the traveler with a bruised forearm and ringing ears.
bills.summary: Make it easier to bring a gun to work

bills.description: During a traffic stop, a traveler does not mention the gun in the glove box, and the officer discovers it unexpectedly. The tense search leaves the traveler trembling and nauseated.
bills.summary: Eliminate requirement that you inform police you have a gun during a traffic stop

bills.description: A traveler buys a gun on impulse and takes it into the van before anyone can cool off. A quarrel over the weapon ends with a bloody cut and a ruined trip schedule.
A relative’s threats cannot trigger a red-flag order, so the family keeps moving from town to town. Exhaustion makes one traveler miss the turn toward the next safe motel.
A school permits guns, and a fight breaks out near the entrance as your party passes through. A traveler is struck by flying glass while helping children escape.
An eighteen-year-old traveler carries concealed into a busy bus station and reaches for it when startled. The resulting panic sends a traveler tumbling down steps, bruising their ribs.
A stranger at a fuel station draws a gun during an argument over the pump and claims the law protects them. A traveler ducks behind the van and bruises their shoulder on the bumper.
A traveler’s pistol permit never needs renewal, even after years without practice. At a campsite, they mishandle the gun and burn their palm while unloading it.
bills.summary: Eliminate renewal requirements for pistol permits, making them lifetime grants

bills.description: A stranger at a fuel station draws a gun during an argument over the pump and claims the law protects them. A traveler ducks behind the van and bruises their shoulder on the bumper.
A threatened neighbor keeps their gun after warnings because red-flag laws are banned. Hearing shots nearby leaves a traveler sleepless, jumpy, and clutching a stress headache.
A passenger’s concealed gun slips from a coat on a crowded train, and the sudden alarm stops the service. Your party waits on the platform while a traveler nurses a bruised knee.
An HOA cannot restrict guns, so a resident practices near the rental where your party is staying. A stray round breaks a window and cuts a traveler with glass.
bills.summary: Prevents HOAs from restricting gun use

bills.description: A frightened family cannot get a red-flag intervention for a violent relative. Hearing shots nearby leaves one traveler trembling and unable to sleep in the van.
A stolen gun purchase cannot be flagged by the merchant’s records, slowing the investigation. Your traveler develops a pounding headache and nausea while explaining the loss.
bills.summary: Bans merchants from using gun-related codes to track purchases

bills.description: A roadside seller deals guns without a license or secure storage, and one weapon vanishes during your party’s visit. A traveler is struck in the scramble when the thief bolts.
bills.summary: Eliminates licensing requirement to sell guns

bills.description: A prohibited buyer obtains ammunition without a background check and later confronts your party at a truck stop. A traveler dives aside, scraping their cheek and knees.
bills.summary: Eliminates background check requirement for buying ammo

bills.description: A traveler acquires powerful machine-gun ammunition from a casual vendor and fires it near camp. The noise stampedes nearby animals, and a fleeing traveler breaks an ankle.
A teen traveler buys a gun and leaves it in a backpack beside the sleeping bags. Another traveler opens the bag, triggering a frantic and injurious scramble.
A stranger points a gun at your party during a dispute over a parking space, certain the expanded rules protect the gesture. The traveler nearest the door has a panic attack and cannot stand.
bills.summary: Legalizes pointing a gun at people in more instances

bills.description: A traveler skips handgun training under the relaxed rule and struggles when the weapon jams at camp. Their hurried handling causes a deep cut and leaves them limping.
At the state fair, concealed weapons mingle with the crowd, and one appears during a ride-line argument. Your party pushes through the gates while a traveler’s shoulder is bruised.
bills.summary: Let people concealed carry at the state fair

bills.description: A driver points a gun at your van after a merge, claiming the situation is permitted now. The shaken passenger vomits and develops a headache while the party pulls over.
bills.summary: Makes it legal to point gun at another person in more scenarios

bills.description: After a shooting near the motel, investigators cannot use ballistic testing to connect the recovered gun to the scene. Your traveler remains there, trembling and unable to sleep after the gunfire.
A parade celebrates the AR-15 as the state gun, and a traveler’s protest draws hostile attention. A thrown rock cuts the traveler’s forehead as the party retreats.
A town cannot enforce its local gun restrictions, and a crowded street festival grows tense with visible weapons. Your party retreats through an alley, where one traveler falls hard.
bills.summary: Ban on localities doing any restrictions on guns

bills.description: A school allows weapons inside, and an accidental discharge sends students and your party running. A traveler cuts their leg climbing over a toppled barrier.
bills.summary: Allow people to carry weapons into schools

bills.description: A church parking-lot dispute escalates under stand-your-ground protections. A traveler crouches behind the van, bruising their knees and shaking until police arrive.
bills.summary: Covering churches under Stand Your Ground Laws

bills.description: A college football game admits guns, and a shove in the concourse turns into a dangerous draw. Your party escapes through a service gate with a traveler’s ankle twisted.
bills.summary: Let people bring guns to college football games

bills.description: A landlord must allow a tenant’s gun, and it is left unsecured beside the rental’s laundry room. A traveler reaches for a dropped towel, falls backward, and bruises their wrist.
bills.summary: Makes it illegal to ban renters from having guns

bills.description: A traveler fleeing a former stalker learns the person can regain firearm access more easily. The party changes hotels repeatedly, while the traveler loses sleep and develops a constant stomachache.
bills.summary: Eases restrictions on people convicted of stalking and DV re: firearms

bills.description: State officers cannot coordinate with federal agents after a gun theft at the truck stop. A traveler waits in the cold for hours, developing numb fingers and a cough.
bills.summary: Bans state from coordinating with ATF

bills.description: A nonresident traveler buys a gun with little scrutiny and stores it under the passenger seat. It slides forward under braking, causing a crash that injures a passenger.
bills.summary: Make it easier for nonresidents to get guns

bills.description: A traveler carries a concealed pistol without a license and forgets it is loaded while unpacking. The discharge damages the van and leaves the traveler bleeding.
A traveler buys a machine gun from a roadside enthusiast and tests it too close to camp. The burst sends everyone running, and a ricochet grazes a traveler’s calf.
A dealer overlooks warning signs when selling a gun to a known violent traveler. An argument at the next motel leaves one party member with a bruised cheek and ringing ears.
bills.summary: Make it easier for criminals to get guns

bills.description: A machine gun enters the local market after the ban is repealed, and a reckless demonstration rattles the roadside campground. The blast leaves a traveler’s ears ringing and sleep impossible.
With the federal gun office closed, a stolen weapon report sits unanswered. The traveler who reported it remains sleepless and jumpy, flinching at every knock.
A threatening gun owner knows federal rules will not be enforced and confronts your party at a fuel station. A traveler ducks away with a bruised shoulder and a racing pulse.
bills.summary: Ban enforcement of federal gun laws

bills.description: A judge demands extensive proof before issuing a red-flag order against a violent relative. The waiting traveler develops insomnia and a stomachache from constant dread.
bills.summary: Make it harder to get red flag orders

bills.description: A young traveler is handed a gun at a roadside gathering and tries to impress everyone. The weapon slips, injuring their foot and ending the day’s drive.
An eighteen-year-old traveler concealed-carries into a crowded café and reaches for the weapon when a tray crashes. The panic sends another traveler into a table.
A shopkeeper hesitates to take a gun from a robber because the new rule threatens punishment for disarming criminals. The robber strikes a traveler in the scramble, leaving a swollen eye.
bills.summary: Make it a crime to take a criminal's gun

bills.description: Your party stops beside a Confederate monument, where locals block the road to prevent its removal. The confrontation leaves a traveler shoved against the van and delays departure.
A town worker faces severe penalties for moving a monument that blocks the only bridge approach. The tense queue brings on a traveler’s migraine and dizziness.
bills.summary: Onerous penalties for removing Confederate monuments

bills.description: A state building flies a Confederate flag over its traveler services desk, and one member refuses to enter. The distress leaves that traveler nauseated and shaking outside.
bills.summary: Require the state fly the Confederate Flag

bills.description: A bounty notice targets anyone who moves a Confederate monument, and an angry crowd mistakes your traveler’s roadside cleanup for vandalism. A thrown stone bruises the traveler’s ribs.
bills.summary: Puts a bounty on anyone who moves a Confederate monument

bills.description: A new monument is raised over a contested memorial site, blocking the town’s bus shelter. Your party waits in rain, and a traveler’s asthma flares.
bills.summary: Making a new Confederate monument to enslaved soldiers

bills.description: A protected war monument forces a detour around a closed plaza. The extra walking leaves a traveler dehydrated, dizzy, and suffering a pounding headache.
Workers cannot remove a monument that has become a gathering point for hecklers. A traveler is harassed while passing and later shakes with anxiety, unable to sleep.

A roadside fertility adviser tells a couple to rely on the rhythm method and dismisses their concerns. Later in the journey, one traveler has nausea and cramps while an untreated concern goes unexamined.
bills.summary: Encouraging women to get pregnant using rhythm method BS

bills.description: A feverish traveler buys over-the-counter ivermectin from a drugstore instead of seeking the treatment the clinic recommended. Their symptoms worsen, forcing a long detour for medical care.
bills.summary: Lets people use ivermectin over the counter

bills.description: A homeopathic practitioner claims broad authority and treats a traveler’s serious infection with diluted drops. The untreated illness spreads before the party reaches a proper clinic.
A traveler with ADHD cannot refill their usual medication because the new restrictions leave the pharmacy unable to dispense it. Their focus deteriorates on the highway, nearly causing a collision.
bills.summary: Functionally bans ADHD patients from receiving Ritalin

bills.description: A naturopath becomes the party’s first-contact provider and dismisses a traveler’s crushing chest pain as fatigue. The delayed diagnosis sends everyone racing toward an emergency room.
bills.summary: Allowing naturopaths to be primary care providers

bills.description: A naturopathic clinic promises to manage every ailment in the van and postpones a traveler’s needed antibiotics. By the next town, the infection has become painful and difficult to treat.
A chiropractor sells a traveler an expensive vial as a cure for dehydration and tells them to skip urgent care. The traveler collapses beside the van before the party finds a clinic.
bills.summary: Allow chiropractors to dispense BS cures

bills.description: A sick traveler buys ivermectin without a prescription and takes it instead of the medicine the urgent-care nurse advised. Nausea and worsening illness force the party off the road.
A loosely regulated chiropractor manipulates a traveler’s injured neck and sends them away dizzy. The party stops driving while the traveler’s headache and balance problems worsen.
A chiropractor prescribes a supposed cure for a traveler’s infection, delaying a real prescription. The fever climbs during the night, leaving the traveler weak, sweaty, and confused.
A chiropractor holds a traveler’s payment in a poorly protected trust account, and the account vanishes when the office closes. The shock brings insomnia and a stress headache that night.
bills.summary: Allows chiropractors to hold more than $1500 in trust for patients

bills.description: A traveler chooses ivermectin over a recommended vaccine before the trip, then falls ill at a crowded stop. Fever, chills, and weakness spread through the traveler while the party isolates.

bills.description: Airport shuttles now announce a new honoree while older signs point elsewhere. Your party drags luggage between terminals in the heat, and one traveler collapses with dehydration.
The airport's old name has vanished from a printed pickup permit. A shuttle leaves your party behind, and the long wait in cold rain brings on a chest-deep cough.
A coastal chart has been revised with a new gulf label but the harbor's buoy guide has not. Your party follows the wrong access road and the van's suspension jolts a passenger's back.

A motel clerk will only explain directions using the newly renamed gulf as a reference. The confusing explanation sends your party through construction, where a falling cone rack bruises a traveler's forearm.
A surprise holiday closes the county records office where your party planned to retrieve a permit. The wasted night in the van leaves one traveler sleepless and irritable enough to snap at everyone.
bills.summary: Makes Charlie Kirk's birthday a holiday

bills.description: A highway dedication has covered familiar mile markers with a new namesake. Your party misses its exit and reaches a steep ramp; the driver grips the wheel until a painful hand cramp sets in.
A renamed highway appears on banners but not on the navigation signs. Your van takes a narrow frontage road, and a mirror clips a post, sending glass into a traveler's cheek.
bills.summary: Naming a highway for Donald Trump

bills.description: A visitor center's coastal map uses the new gulf name while its trail pamphlet uses the old one. Your party hikes the wrong way under blazing sun, and a traveler develops heat exhaustion.
A town's celebration of a leader's first hundred days blocks the only bridge through its center. Waiting in idling traffic fills the van with fumes, giving a passenger a splitting headache.
A paper atlas and a newly painted coastal sign use different names for the same gulf. The driver brakes hard to read them, and an unbelted cooler strikes a traveler's shin.
bills.summary: Renaming it the Gulf of America

bills.description: At a clinic, a receptionist treats a traveler's political distress as a named disorder and refuses ordinary counseling. The dismissal deepens that traveler's panic until they cannot sleep.
bills.summary: Make Trump Derangement Syndrome a mental illness

bills.description: A plaza statue unveiling crowds the fuel station beside your route. A jostling spectator knocks a heavy camera into a traveler's temple, leaving a painful welt.
bills.summary: Spend $25K on statue of Charlie Kirk

bills.description: A courthouse display proclaims that a powerful man broke no laws and a guard repeats it while denying your party directions. The argument leaves one traveler shaking and too distracted to eat.
bills.summary: Resolution stating Donald Trump didn't break any laws

bills.description: A roadside rally celebrates special political privileges, and its crowd surrounds your parked van demanding agreement. One traveler is shoved against the door and suffers a bruised hip.
bills.summary: Lets Donald Trump vote and have a gun in Oklahoma even though he's a felon

bills.description: A mass-deportation revolving fund finances an enforcement checkpoint that holds your van while officers inspect nearby vehicles. Heat trapped in the idling cabin leaves a traveler dizzy and nauseated.

bills.description: A town festival closes its grocery and pharmacy for a leader's named day. After hours without medication, one traveler develops a pounding rebound headache.
Old route signs have been removed for a highway renaming, leaving only hand-painted arrows. Your party follows one into a muddy shoulder, where a passenger slips while pushing and strains a wrist.
The airport's new name confuses a rideshare driver and your party waits beside the exhaust lanes. A traveler breathes the fumes until dizziness forces them to sit on the curb.

New highway plaques conceal the exit numbers your party needs. The driver makes a late merge, and a truck's wake slams the van hard enough to leave a traveler nauseated.
A bat exhibit has relabeled its specimens and moved the old guidebook to storage. A startled bat escapes during the confusion, and a traveler is scratched while ducking beneath a display.

bills.description: The interstate is promoted under a new name on billboards, while emergency dispatch still uses the old one. Your party misses a crash detour and sits in heat until one traveler faints.

A public school without standards has no posted emergency map during a windstorm. Your party shelters in the wrong hallway, where shattered glass cuts one traveler's ankle.

bills.description: A rent-control ban lets a residential sublet raise its monthly price beyond your party's budget. Sleeping in the hot van instead leaves one traveler wheezing from exhaust and dust.
With rent controls eliminated, an apartment manager raises the monthly rent after your party has unloaded its bags. Repacking in rain leaves a traveler chilled, feverish, and unable to rest.
A county line is contested by rival Illinois signs, and both claim the same fuel stop. A hostile crowd blocks your van, and a traveler is struck in the shoulder by a tossed bottle.
bills.summary: Trying to take part of Illinois

bills.description: Southern Minnesota's takeover talk has put up competing barricades on the county road. Your party detours through deep gravel, where a passenger bites their tongue during a hard jolt.
bills.summary: Try to take over Southern Minnesota

bills.description: A sign says the county is being ceded to Indiana while the next sign denies it, confusing the route to your motel. The driver brakes suddenly at a barricade, and a traveler suffers a whiplash headache.
bills.summary: Starts process of ceding part of the state to Indiana

bills.description: People claiming seized Illinois land demand tolls from passing vehicles. When your party refuses, a thrown stone cracks a window and cuts a traveler's forehead.
A bay renaming has replaced the old ferry notices, and your party queues at the wrong dock. Rushing across the lot, a traveler slips on algae and badly bruises a knee.
bills.summary: Rename Delaware Bay as Bay of New Jersey

bills.description: County-secession banners divide the roadside town, and a hostile group surrounds your van when it crosses the wrong side. A traveler is yanked from the door and dislocates a shoulder.
bills.summary: Counties can secede and join Texas

bills.description: Oregon and Idaho flags mark different versions of the same county road. Your party follows the wrong boundary patrol route into darkness, and the exhausted driver develops tunnel-vision anxiety.
bills.summary: Secede from Oregon to join Idaho

bills.description: A Washington county has placed confusing secession checkpoints along the highway. Your party waits for hours in cold rain, leaving one traveler with numb feet and a deep cough.

bills.description: A clinic physician refuses to examine a traveler's infected scrape for a personal reason. The wound worsens overnight, bringing fever and throbbing pain.
bills.summary: Allows doctor to opt out of treating patients for any reason

bills.description: A nurse declines to change a traveler's dressing because she objects to the treatment plan. The exposed wound catches road dust and leaves the patient shivering with fear.
bills.summary: Allows doctors and nurses to refuse to do things they don't believe in

bills.description: A doctor refuses the anti-nausea treatment your motion-sick traveler requests. The repeated vomiting leaves that traveler weak, dizzy, and unable to keep water down.
bills.summary: Let doctors refuse treatments they don't like

bills.description: At an urgent-care desk, staff say they may take no action for any reason and send your party away. A traveler with a sprained ankle tries to walk back to the van and collapses.

bills.description: A physician rejects a needed treatment after hearing a traveler's beliefs. The untreated pain prevents sleep and leaves that traveler trembling through the next day's drive.

bills.summary: Allow doctors to refuse to operate for any reason

Shen Yun Day closes the town theater and library, including the cool room your party needed during a heat wave. A traveler becomes dizzy and vomits after waiting outside.
A debt collector calls the motel room repeatedly and threatens to find your party on the road. The sleepless night leaves the driver jittery, and a sudden swerve bruises a passenger's ribs.
bills.summary: Makes it easier for debt collectors to harass you

bills.description: A cheerful roadside seminar promises quick wealth through a pyramid scheme and pressures your party to buy in. Leaving abruptly, a traveler slips on the wet entry ramp and strains a hip.

A lender boasts that politicians want to dismantle the consumer bureau while refusing to correct a gas-station payment error. The dispute keeps your party waiting, and one traveler develops chest-tightness and panic.
Telemarketers repeatedly call an elderly traveler in your party about a Medicare plan, even after bedtime. The lost sleep leaves that traveler confused and nauseated during the next leg.

bills.description: A crypto scammer invokes new immunity protections while refusing to return your party's deposit, making recovery nearly impossible. The loss leaves a traveler panicked, hungry, and unable to sleep.
